Fog alignment, map boundary, session developer gate and entrance pixels (2026-10-30)

All four reports submitted by Kittingsl; implemented and verified, IN PROGRESS / awaiting human confirmation.
Refs #177 (BUG-031), #178 (BUG-032), #179 (enhancement / BUG-033), #180 (BUG-034).
Broader #112 terrain blending and #93 artwork criteria are not closed by this batch.

Acceptance / implementation
#177: memory ownership projects dark wall caps 48px north and brighter faces toward their ground base.
  A 16px source sample resolves the half-tile lift; per-pixel owners retain each source tile's explored bit.
  Unchanged frames return the cached canvas without pixel uploads. Changed explored bits update their projected pixels.
  Tile hash/dimensions/module revision invalidate derived ownership, retaining a same-size canvas where possible.
#178: viewport-wide unexplored memory color matches the padded canvas edges, avoiding the black/color seam.
  Virtual off-map solid rock caps cover the southern exposed floor strip after real wall/actor rows.
  Memory ownership also includes this virtual cap strip. Camera follow and invisible movement bounds are unchanged.
#179: all builds start hidden. Host captures Ctrl+Shift+F2 at keydown, including fast taps.
  F2/backquote/query alone do not unlock. Once unlocked, F2/backquote/DEV retain normal panel behavior.
  Disable dev tools resets ongoing cheats and overlays, safely resolves noclip, clears temporary quality and relocks.
  Access and temporary quality live only in the HMR resource registry; no URL/local/session storage writes.
  New runs/HMR retain an unlocked session; full page reload starts locked with tool defaults. Ordinary settings remain intact.
#180: entrance source has three stray bright texels at (47,46), (48,46), (63,46).
  The entrance blit replaces these with adjacent stone #39322c; all other RGBA pixels are unchanged.
  Tile cache version increments so cached and cold wall rows receive the correction after HMR. Owner atlas untouched.

- npm run check: passed (check ok, checks ok, check-assets/UI-assets ok, check-guard ok).

- New pure memory-field check: raised caps, face/floor ownership, side alignment, margins and virtual south caps.

- Headless Edge, native input: unlock, panel close/open, freeze/noclip controls, reset button, old-query rejection.
- Actual HMR reports game.ts swapped/state kept; access/toggle survive HMR and a new run. Full reload relocks and clears toggles.
- Exported production JavaScript: hidden by default even with ?debug=1; native unlock works; reload clears access/toggle;
  disable relocks; ordinary F2 cannot bypass; debug operations do not write localStorage. No console errors.
- Browser fog: 48 edge/corner combinations across DPR 1/1.25/2 and full/half dark resolution; maximum background variation 1 RGB level.
- Twelve projected-cap/face pixel checks across DPR/quality/fractional camera pans pass. Pure darkness returns no memory and stays black.
- Twenty unchanged memory frames upload zero images; exploration removal/re-addition and changed caves refresh correctly.
- Memory HMR refreshes pixels/ownership while reusing the same canvas; memory rendering leaves State unchanged.
- Actual seed-42 escape renders reviewed at all four edges: no exposed southern floor strip.
- Entrance sprite comparison: exactly three changed pixels, all replaced with expected opaque stone; no other pixel changes.
